caption: Palette source: the palette-source colours laid across the matrix and scrolled
why: The studio's audioreactive build lets the person pick a second set of colours - the palette source - that its audio-reactive palettes are built from. Palette source reads that set, where Palette reads the segment's own palette.

Use it when an effect should match the colours the audio palettes use, independently of the segment's palette. On a build without that usermod it falls back to the segment's palette, so the effect still works. Its neighbours: Palette reads the segment's palette - almost always the one you want; Colour ramp is colours of your own.
steps: **Coords** `u` times 1 (a **Multiply**, the spread) plus a clock (**Time** times 0.2) goes into the **index**: where in the palette source to read, wrapping at 1 - laid once across the matrix, scrolling.
The `color` goes to the **Output**: the palette source laid across the matrix, scrolling.
In the studio the palette source is set in the side panel with the palette; on the device, on the WLED page beside it.

try.label: Dim
try.text: brightness 0.3: the same colours at a third.

try.label: Three times across
try.text: the spread Multiply at 3: the palette source repeats three times across the matrix.

try.label: Faster
try.text: the clock's Multiply at 1: the colours scroll five times as fast.
